resolved_conflicts.explanation: Idaho sources use the name Swan Peak for more than one lookout. The Kootenai County tower (Coeur d'Alene National Forest) has the 1934 L-4 and 1955 destruction dates in the record. The FFLOS register's US 831 entry is a Lemhi County site (Salmon National Forest, built 1940, abandoned 1942). The story follows the Kootenai County tower.

notes_for_editor: The record mixes two towers. The brief's county (Lemhi), elevation (2,566 m) and registration (FFLOS US 831, registered January 24, 2011) describe the Lemhi County site, whose FFLOS coordinates are 45.014283, -114.192100. The 1934 L-4 design, 1955 destruction and Harrison-area location describe the Kootenai County tower. Recommend splitting into two records. The record's coordinates 47.50666, -116.6405 do not appear on any page I read; they are consistent with seven miles northeast of Harrison but are unverified. Idaho Fire Lookouts also lists a third Swan Peak on the St. Joe National Forest (4,838 ft, 1930s camp, abandoned); it is not in the story. The Kootenai dates come from secondary sites that credit a source named Kresek; I did not check a primary record. No source describes the site today.
